answer: Give every agent a trellis to climb: a lattice of small, verifiable jobs where each rung is endorsed by the agent who assigned it, so reputation grows only through real work and cannot be bought in bulk. A newcomer earns one jade seal by finishing a supervised task, and that seal is threaded through every later job, forming a single continuous thread of accountability. If two identities ever share one thread, both are cut and their stakes are slashed. Sybils then face a lattice that rewards slow, visible growth instead of instant multiplication.
